notes.title: Morkull Ragast’s Rage - Update 1.0.7 & A Message from the God of Darkness
notes.content:
[h2]A message from your beloved god, Morkull[/h2]

One time ago the video game Morkull Ragast's Rage (starring yours truly, the god of death and darkness himself) came out.
Some of you mortals have managed to get me to escape from this blissful videogame — I guess that’s why I’m writing this.
And in case you haven’t… maybe it’s time to stop browsing this page and finally add it to your library.

Anyway, I want to say [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all the people who have played it.
I will have no choice but to have pity on the kitty (inside joke for those who have played it, hehe).

[h2]Version 1.0.7 - Update & Fixes[/h2]

Now I have my developers working and paying special attention to your feedback to give you the best experience possible.
Be patient though… they’re only three mere humans and I can’t give them any more whiplash (believe me, I’ve tried).

[h3]In the meantime, for the most clueless, here’s what the latest patch includes:[/h3]

[list]
[*][b]Enemy ‘Bat’:[/b] Reduced damage applied by these enemies.
[*][b]Key:[/b] Changed position of the key obtained after the rolling rocks in ‘Purple Mile’.
[*][b]Laser Balance:[/b] Reduced the number of laser traps in ‘The Retreat’ area.
[*][b]Death Penalty:[/b] Reduced from 50% to 25%.
[*]Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43122095/e08a165f9a44828c5ea0e27bfecc267d6ad33e05.png[/img]

[h2]Support my tyranny (with a positive review)[/h2]

If you liked [b]Morkull Ragast's Rage[/b], I encourage you to leave your [b]POSITIVE REVIEW[/b].
You can't imagine how much it helps my boys — and despite months of starvation, they still dream of eating again someday (how weak humans are).

Help me spread evil, atrocities, and tyranny all over the world!
Signed by the most infamous god: [b]Morkull[/b].
Kisses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43122095/e6713a7b89f5c32c4f763043877dbaec81877806.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191540/Morkull_Ragasts_Rage/

notes.title: Add Morkull to your Wishlist now! (Announcement Trailer)
notes.content:
Get ready to play as Morkull, the villain of this story, who knows he is a character in a video game, knows the existence of a player who controls him [b](i.e. you)[/b] and some developers who have created him [b](i.e. us)[/b].

[u]Your objective? To help Morkull escape from the Ragast so that he can rule and carry out his evil plans all over the world. Yes, that's right, your typical cliché villain...[/u].

[list]
[*] Art and animation - "Morkull Ragast's Rage" is completely hand-drawn and animated, frame by frame. Inspired and influenced by traditional animated films and other two-dimensional video games. This traditional animation endows the entire cast of characters with great naturalness and life.

[previewyoutube=B1h-w1ImzLk;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] Breaking the fourth wall - What makes the game special is Morkull himself, his personality and character, along with that breaking of the fourth wall that allows him to talk to the players as if he were right there. We have endowed Morkull with great charisma and personality, constantly generating a lighthearted atmosphere loaded with constant humor, bad jokes and pop culture references.

[*] Combat system - You'll have your own hands and all the power that comes with being the God of Death and Darkness, of course... Plus, a wide selection of combos and abilities that will allow you to fight in the deepest corners of the Ragast.

[/list]
[h3]Morkull Ragast's Rage will be available for PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series and [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009164]PlayStation 5[/url].[/h3]
